item.title: Trump executive order would split up MMR vaccine
item.description: The Trump administration is drafting an executive order to reduce childhood vaccinations, including separating the MMR vaccine into three shots.

item.title: July was the hottest month on record in the U.S.
item.description: New federal data shows July was the hottest month on record for the contiguous U.S., according to NOAA. The data goes back to 1895.

item.title: Appeals court allows social media addiction lawsuits to proceed
item.description: A U.S. Appeals Court ruled Monday that thousands of lawsuits against Meta, TikTok, and other social media companies can move forward.

item.title: Trump's new White House counsel may face subpoena battle
item.description: Will Scharf will become White House counsel on Sept. 1, President Trump announced. The appointment could lead to a confrontation over subpoenas.
